tasks.short: Choose the construction method from the specification.

steps.what: Extract the job specification clauses for this package.

loop.input: the specification and the package name
loop.output: clauses that name a material or a tolerance
loop.check: each clause cites a specification paragraph
loop.stop: stop when the package name is not in the specification
loop.why_not_simpler: specifications are long prose, not a single table

steps.what: Study specifications to determine the construction methods.
Record the method the site will use.

tasks.design: Clauses that name a material or a tolerance are extracted from the specification in {DOCS}. The construction manager studies them and determines the construction method, then records it on the {PROJECT} plan. The extract does not choose the method. A package the specification does not name is read by the manager in full.
tasks.previous_blocker: The method was chosen in a meeting before anyone had found the tolerance clause.
tasks.enabler_now: A named package can pull the clauses that constrain it. The method is still a judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting clauses, a site constraint the specification ignores, and two methods that both comply.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows the crew, the access, and which compliant method will actually get built.
tasks.altitude: The clauses are found before the meeting. The manager still determines the method and still records it.

reach.task: Read the specification clauses that constrain a choice, then choose.
reach.learn: An extract is not a method. This manager still determines how the package will be built.

evidence.claim: Paragraphs that mention a package can be listed. They do not rank construction methods.
Choosing a method can affect safety and cost. The manager chooses it. The job digest treats this kind of professional judgement as manual, with drafting help only.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Package name and specification paragraph id, produced by the specification set. If the package name is absent, extraction stops. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Search the existing specification store before a new index.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Whether specifications are searchable text or scanned sheets.
Who else may set a method.
research_questions: What share of packages are named in the specification?
How often do two clauses conflict?

already_counted.description: The manager still determines the method.
The manager still records the method.

incremental.description: The manager adds a package name when the specification uses a different word.

approvals.approved_version: package id and the method text shown to the manager

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Choosing the method stays with the manager. Saving is finding the clauses, and it shrinks when specifications are scans the search cannot read.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the week's construction and maintenance plan.
Direct activities for construction of the structures.
Change the day's order for facilities or systems work.

tasks.design: The week's plan is shown from {PROJECT}. The construction manager directs activities for the structures, facilities, and systems, and changes the day's order when the plan does not fit the site. The plan does not direct the work. Maintenance and construction stay under the manager's instruction on the day.
tasks.previous_blocker: Direction was a morning tour with no shared picture of the week, so two supervisors booked the same crane.
tasks.enabler_now: A week plan can be shown. Directing the day cannot be skipped.
tasks.still_hard: A breakdown, a delivery, and two trades who need the same space.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees the clash on the ground and says who goes first.
tasks.altitude: The week is visible. Directing the work stays with the manager on site. The plan gains no authority of its own.

reach.task: Direct the day's work from a plan and change it when the room does not match the plan.
reach.learn: The plan is a picture. This manager still gives the order.

evidence.claim: A plan can show the week's activities. It cannot direct people through a clash on site.
Directing work is the manager's authority. No score of supervisors is stored. The job digest keeps people-management judgement manual.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Activity id and planned day, produced by the issued schedule. A changed order is written by the manager and does not silently rewrite the baseline. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the week from the existing plan.
unknowns: Who may change the day's order besides this manager.
How maintenance work is separated from new construction on this job.
research_questions: Does the morning start from the issued plan?
How often do two trades need the same space?

already_counted.description: The manager still directs the work.
The manager still changes the day's order.

incremental.description: No extra tool. The manager only confirms the week plan is the issued one.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Direction is on site and stays there. Saving is showing the week plan, and it is small because the clashes are not in the plan.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Oversee painting, plumbing, and other craft work.

steps.what: Show the craft package and its acceptance points.
Oversee craft work such as painting or plumbing.
Accept or reject the craft work that was seen.

tasks.design: Acceptance points for the craft package are shown from {PROJECT}. The construction manager oversees the painting, plumbing, or other craft work on site and accepts or rejects only what was seen. A photo in the file is not the acceptance. Work that is covered up before the visit is not accepted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Acceptance was a signature on a sheet the manager had not stood in front of.
tasks.enabler_now: The points to look at can be listed. The looking cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Covered work, a craft lead who wants a signature today, and a standard the manager has not seen applied here before.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can see a finish that meets the words and fails the eye, or the reverse.
tasks.altitude: The points are listed. Overseeing the craft and accepting the work stay on site with the manager.

reach.role: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers
reach.task: Accept repair work only after seeing it.
reach.learn: A checklist is not acceptance. This manager still stands in front of the work.

evidence.claim: A package can list acceptance points. It cannot see paint or pipework.
Accepting craft work is the manager's decision about the building. It is not taken from a photograph. No score of the craft worker is stored.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Package id and acceptance-point id, produced by the quality program. Acceptance is recorded only with the manager's visit date. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the acceptance points already on the package.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Which crafts this manager oversees directly.
Whether a clerk of works also accepts the same work.
research_questions: Are acceptance points written per package?
What share of work is covered before inspection?

already_counted.description: The manager still oversees the craft on site.
The manager still accepts or rejects what was seen.

incremental.description: The manager adds an acceptance point when a craft specification changes.

approvals.approved_version: package id and the accept-or-reject note from the visit

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Oversight is the visit. Saving is the list of points, and it is lost when the package has no written points and the manager still decides what to look at.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the incident form for this construction site.
Investigate accidents and delays at the construction site.
Write the note from what was seen, not a category.

tasks.design: An incident form opens in {WORKFLOW} with the site and the time. The construction manager investigates the damage, accident, or delay on site and writes the note from what was seen and from the procedure that should have been followed. A category list does not name the cause. The form does not notify an authority by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The first story told in the cabin became the record, before anyone stood at the place.
tasks.enabler_now: A form can hold the later note. The investigation is the visit and the questions.
tasks.still_hard: People who will not speak, a scene that has been moved, and a delay that is commercial rather than physical.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can tell a tidy story from what the site actually shows.
tasks.altitude: The form is ready. The investigation stays with the manager. No category is allowed to become the cause.

reach.task: Go to the place and write what was found before any category is applied.
reach.learn: A form can store a note. This manager still determines what happened.

evidence.claim: A form can store a report after a person writes it. Classifying a free-text cause is a different step and is not used here.

The job digest allows a routed incident register, and says a person approves status. Naming blame, especially of a worker, is a staff matter. This note does not score anyone. Works-council consent would be needed before any monitoring of staff, and none is added.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Site id and event time, produced by the manager at the scene. Cause text is written by the manager. The form has no automatic cause field. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the existing incident form before a new register.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Which events must be reported to an authority, and by whom.
Whether the site already has a statutory incident book.
research_questions: Who is allowed to notify an authority?
Are causes currently picked from a dropdown?

already_counted.description: The manager still investigates on site.
The manager still writes the note.

incremental.description: The manager checks the form still has no automatic cause field.

approvals.approved_version: site id, event time, and the note text shown to the manager

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The investigation is the task. Saving is opening a blank form, and even that is small. A week of serious incidents does not get faster because the form was ready.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still chooses the method, still directs the work, and still investigates an accident. A specification extract can be on the table first.
reach: Architectural and engineering managers study a specification before they choose a method, and the choice stays a person.
Loss prevention managers go to the place of an incident before they name a cause.
skills_to_grow: Separate a specification clause from the method the site will actually use.
Write an accident note from what was seen, and do not let a category pick the cause.
role.ambitious_version: The specification clauses for a package are extracted before the method meeting, and the method is still the manager's.
